limits: Single product per model, piecewise-constant rates, lexicographic LP routing. Calendar or operating exposure as entered. standby_pair assets use the 0.2 dedicated exponential channel; standby groups use the shared crew and spares. Loss groups record co-occurring outages and can include incidental failures; counterfactual gains are reported separately. Unmet demand is classified lost, recovered or potentially deferred only under the stated recovery policy. Economic values derive solely from entered assumptions. Mean intervals are approximate and do not account for repeated stopping checks. Results depend on study inputs. SIL/PFD and standards conformity are outside scope.

larger_product_tank.note: P10-P90 are per-run spreads; ci95 is the sampling interval on the mean (paired for difference).

basis.statistic: Lower-tail percentiles and approximate Student-t mean intervals
